annotations.title: Create a shared expense ledger page

description: Use this when a group wants to track shared costs for a trip, a shared house or an event and split them fairly: it publishes a shared web page where everyone adds what they paid, and returns a public link to share and a private organizer link. Optional starting expenses and payments can be included. Amounts use whole minor units of one currency (no conversion). Members are first names, 2 to 30. Does not move money, convert currencies or send reminders. Do not use for a one-off bill split that nobody else needs to see.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, KWD.

expenses.description: Optional expenses to add right away.

amount.description: Total paid, in the ledger currency, e.g. "84.50" (or 12000 for JPY). Can be left out for an exact split: the parts are added up.

description.description: What it was for, e.g. Dinner at Taberna.

paid_by.description: Name of the member who paid, exactly as in the member list, e.g. Ana.

parts.description: For exact or shares: member name -> amount or shares, e.g. {"Ana": "30.00", "Ben": "54.50"} or {"Ana": 2, "Ben": 1}.

split.description: How to split: equal (default), exact (amount per person in parts) or shares (whole-number shares per person in parts).

split_between.description: For an equal split: the members who share it, e.g. ["Ana", "Ben"]. Leave out to split between everyone.

members.description: First names of the people sharing costs (2-30), e.g. ["Ana", "Ben", "Chi"].

note.description: Optional note shown on the page, e.g. Add every shared cost here.

number_format.description: How people type amounts on the page, e.g. 1,234.56. Default depends on the currency (EUR uses 1.234,56).

payments.description: Optional payments already made between members.

from.description: Member who paid the money back, e.g. Ben.

to.description: Member who received it, e.g. Ana.

time_zone.description: Optional IANA time zone for dates on the page, e.g. Europe/Lisbon. Default UTC.

title.description: Name of the ledger, e.g. Lisbon trip 2026.

name: create_expense_ledger
